comment: Deployment provenance manifest (ADR 0007). Addresses from Uniswap's official deployment record (Uniswap/docs content/protocols/v4/deployments.mdx, 'Monad: 143'). These deployments are direct (non-proxy), so each entry pins the keccak256 of the runtime bytecode observed via rpc.monad.xyz on 2026-07-28; the live test recomputes the hashes and asserts the selectors/topics the adapter uses are present, which turns any redeployment into a red suite instead of a silent drift. Sourcify reports no verified source for chain 143 (checked 2026-07-28) and the Monadscan explorer cross-check needs a MONADSCAN_API_KEY, so the vendored artifacts are anchored to the chain by bytecode identity rather than an explorer-derived ABI.
